exposure: Early echocardiographic parameters (PDA diameter, LA/AO ratio)
outcome: Persistence of hemodynamically significant patent ductus arteriosus (hsPDA) at 14 days postnatally
cohort: The study included 120 very-low-birth-weight infants admitted to Zhongshan People's Hospital between May 2020 and August 2023.
finding: Early echocardiographic parameters, specifically PDA diameter and LA/AO ratio, in combination with the PDW index, are effective predictors of persistent hemodynamically significant patent ductus arteriosus (hsPDA) in preterm infants.
